description: 大分県河川水位観測データ [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大分県. このデータセットは大分県内の河川水位観測局及び観測水位に関するデータです。 公開しているデータは以下のとおりです。 １．河川水位観測局メタデータ ●ファイル名：440001riverwlgeodata. geojson 概要：河川水位観測局（水位センサーの設置個所）自体に関する情報をまとめたものです。 GoeJSON形... Coverage: 大分県. The portal files it under the publisher 大分県. Its tags are 位置情報, 水位, 水防, 河川, 災害. It offers 45 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, txt, zip. The portal shows 2026-05-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
